title: Triviality on two slices and one fibre is open in a product family
statement: Let $f:X\to S$ and $g:Y\to S$ be flat [def-weil-flat-morphism], proper [def-weil-proper-morphism] morphisms of schemes [def-weil-scheme-over-base] of finite presentation [def-sbc-locally-finite-presentation] such that, for every morphism $T\to S$, with base changes $f_T:X_T=X\times_ST\to T$ and $g_T:Y_T=Y\times_ST\to T$ [def-pc-base-change], the canonical maps $\mathcal O_T\to(f_T)_*\mathcal O_{X_T}$ and $\mathcal O_T\to(g_T)_*\mathcal O_{Y_T}$ are isomorphisms. Let $\sigma:S\to X$ and $\tau:S\to Y$ be sections [def-pc-section] of $f$ and $g$, let $s\in S$, and let $\mathcal L$ be an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module] on $X\times_SY$ [def-pc-fibre-product]. If the pullbacks [def-pc-module-pullback] $(1\times\tau)^*\mathcal L$ along $1\times\tau:X=X\times_SS\to X\times_SY$ and $(\sigma\times1)^*\mathcal L$ along $\sigma\times1:Y=S\times_SY\to X\times_SY$ are trivial, and the restriction of $\mathcal L$ to the fibre $(X\times_SY)_s=(X\times_SY)\times_S\operatorname{Spec}\kappa(s)$ [def-weil-residue-field] is trivial, then there is an open neighbourhood $U$ of $s$ such that $\mathcal L$ is trivial on $(X\times_SY)_U$.

proof.text: For the special fibre over s, apply the Kunneth lemma in degree one to X_s and Y_s. The universal pushforward hypotheses give H^0(X_s,O)=κ(s)=H^0(Y_s,O), while the sections σ(s) and τ(s) are κ(s)-rational points. Thus the injective map supplied by lem-sc-picard-h1-product-injective is the map induced by pullback along the slices (1,τ(s)):X_s→X_s×_{κ(s)}Y_s and (σ(s),1):Y_s→X_s×_{κ(s)}Y_s, which are the fibres at s of 1×τ and σ×1.

Apply the H1 multiple Picard flat-proper lemma with the product family h:X×_S Y→S as f, the two families X→S and Y→S as the X_i, and the morphisms u_1=1×τ:X→X×_S Y and u_2=σ×1:Y→X×_S Y (morphisms over S). The product h is flat, proper and of finite presentation (stable under base change and composition). Universal pushforward for h: for T→S, the base change pr_1:X_T×_T Y_T→X_T of g_T along the flat morphism f_T gives, by flat base change in degree 0 (lem-pc-flat-base-change-cohom, g_T being quasi-compact and quasi-separated), (pr_1)_*O=f_T^*(g_T)_*O_{Y_T}=f_T^*O_T=O_{X_T}, hence (h_T)_*O=(f_T)_*O_{X_T}=O_T; for X→S and Y→S it is the hypothesis. Since (1×τ)^*L and (σ×1)^*L are trivial, the loci Z_1,Z_2 are all of S, so the containment Z⊂Z_1∩Z_2 holds trivially. The fibre triviality of L at s puts s in Z, and by Step 1 the map H^1((X×_S Y)_s,O)→H^1(X_s,O)⊕H^1(Y_s,O) induced by u_1,u_2 (whose fibres at s are the slices) is injective. Hence there is an open U∋s with Z∩U=U, i.e. L restricted to (X×_S Y)_U is h_U^*N for an invertible N on U; shrinking U so that N is trivial, L is trivial on (X×_S Y)_U.

lean.statement: theorem picard_product_open {S X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ S) (g : Y ⟶ S) [Flat f] [IsProper f] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation f] [Flat g] [IsProper g] [LocallyOfFinitePresentation g] (σ : S ⟶ X) (τ : S ⟶ Y) (hσ : σ ≫ f = 𝟙 S) (hτ : τ ≫ g = 𝟙 S) (s : S) (L : (pullback f g).Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (hO : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd f t))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (hO' : ∀ {T : Scheme.{u}} (t : T ⟶ S), IsIso ((Classical.choose (Scheme.Modules.exists_tensorPullbackAdjunction (pullback.snd g t))).unit.app (SheafOfModules.unit T.ringCatSheaf))) (h₁ : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.lift (𝟙 X) (f ≫ τ) (by simp [hτ]))).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit X.ringCatSheaf)) (h₂ : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.lift (g ≫ σ) (𝟙 Y) (by simp [hσ]))).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit Y.ringCatSheaf)) (hs : Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback ((pullback.fst f g ≫ f).fiberι s)).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit _)) : ∃ U : S.Opens, s ∈ U ∧ Nonempty ((Scheme.Modules.tensorPullback (pullback.fst (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι)).obj L ≅ SheafOfModules.unit (pullback (pullback.fst f g ≫ f) U.ι).ringCatSheaf)
